references.text: God gave Oreb and Zeeb, the princes of Midian, into their hands - this verse refers directly back to the capture of these two princes.
The psalm mentions Oreb and Zeeb as examples of God's victory over Israel's enemies, and asks for a similar victory over current enemies.
Isaiah refers to the slaughter of Midian at the Rock of Oreb as an image of God's coming judgment on Assyria.
The preceding verse where Gideon sent word to Ephraim to cut off the Midianites at the Jordan, which led to the capture of Oreb and Zeeb.
The psalm mentions Midian and their princes Oreb and Zeeb who were destroyed, and compares them with other enemies of Israel.
